n6d7199627b6.s: Which of the following is NOT a Panchsheel principle for tribal development?
o: Tribal rights in land and forests should be respected
Tribal people should be relied upon and trained for their own administration
Results should be judged by money spent rather than by the quality of human character evolved
Administration should be minimised and conducted through tribal institutions
n6d7199627b6.x: Panchsheel requires results to be judged by the quality of human character evolved, not by money spent; the other three are Panchsheel principles.

n7b4f194b9f0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding forest diversion after the Forest Rights Act?
o: Forest diversion is permissible before completion of FRA claims if the project is of public importance
Completion of FRA processes is a prerequisite before forest diversion under the FCA
Gram Sabha consent is relevant to the FRA process
Niyamgiri saw Gram Sabha rejection of bauxite mining
n7b4f194b9f0.x: MoEFCC guidelines barred forest diversion under the FCA until FRA processes, especially Gram Sabha consent, were complete, a position upheld by the Supreme Court.

n6fc7ae5f4ee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about processing of claims under the Forest Rights Act, 2006?
o: The Gram Sabha passes resolutions on claims
Claims are examined by Sub-Divisional and District Level Committees
Each of these committees consists of nine members
The committees include revenue, tribal and forest officials and elected panchayat members
n6fc7ae5f4ee.x: The Sub-Divisional and District Level Committees are six-member bodies, not nine-member; the other statements are correct.

na2fb91a9128.s: Which of the following is NOT a reported gap in Forest Rights Act implementation?
o: Strong MoTA capacity ensuring complete CFR implementation
Excessive focus on individual titles over CFR
na2fb91a9128.x: The identified gap is weak, not strong, MoTA capacity; the other three are reported implementation gaps.

ndad47ce7baf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about scholarships for SC and ST students?
o: The Post-Matric Scholarship for SCs is the largest central scheme for SC students
ST pre-matric and post-matric scholarships are centrally sponsored schemes
National Fellowship, Top Class and National Overseas are central sector schemes
The cost of the SC Post-Matric Scholarship is shared in the ratio 75:25
ndad47ce7baf.x: The SC Post-Matric Scholarship cost is shared in the ratio 60:40, not 75:25; the other statements are correct.

nindian-society-37-17.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: TRIFED / Tribes India E-Marketplace – Marketplace for tribal artisans and forest-produce collectors
PM-JANMAN Monitoring Dashboard – Saturation dashboard for 11 interventions across 75 PVTG communities
SHRESHTA Portal – Sickle Cell screening cards for tribal populations
Sickle Cell Mission Portal – Tracking of sickle cell screening cards
nindian-society-37-17.x: SHRESHTA handles online CBT and seat allotment for SC students; sickle cell screening cards are tracked on the Sickle Cell Mission Portal.

n513d260648d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)?
o: It was set up in 2001 by splitting the joint SC/ST corporation
It lends to STs with income up to three times the poverty line
It runs the Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
n513d260648d.x: NSTFDC lends to STs with income up to double, not three times, the poverty line.

n3da37bb0160.s: Which of the following tribal revolt–leader pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Srikakulam Girijan movement (1967-70) – Alluri Sitarama Raju
n3da37bb0160.x: The Srikakulam Girijan movement was led by Vempatapu Satyanarayana and Adibhatla Kailasam; Alluri Sitarama Raju led the Rampa rebellion.

n065050cd551.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Stand-Up India?
o: It is administered by the Ministry of Finance
Every bank branch is to lend to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower
It is meant exclusively for existing enterprises
n065050cd551.x: Stand-Up India supports greenfield enterprises; it is not meant exclusively for existing enterprises.

n122cea03901.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Birsa Munda's Ulgulan?
o: It led to the enactment of the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act, 1876
It opposed land-grabbing and forced labour
Its objective included the establishment of Abua Raj
n122cea03901.x: The Ulgulan led to the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act of 1908, not 1876; the other statements are correct.

n221c2723cb8.s:
Assertion (A): Private non-tribal mining companies may obtain mining leases in Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh if the Gram Sabha gives consent.
Reason (R): The State is barred from leasing Scheduled Area land to non-tribals.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n221c2723cb8.x: The State is barred from leasing Scheduled Area land to non-tribals, so mining is left to State undertakings or tribal cooperatives; Gram Sabha consent does not validate a private non-tribal lease.

n3d54ed6a1fd.s:
Assertion (A): MoTA sought MoEFCC funds for managing Community Forest Resource areas vested in Gram Sabhas.
Reason (R): Eviction orders in Agasthyamalai were criticised for ignoring the Forest Rights Act.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3d54ed6a1fd.x: Both statements are true, but they are separate issues: the CFR funding request is not explained by the criticism of the Agasthyamalai eviction orders.

nda586c99a45.s: The NAMASTE scheme is implemented by:
nda586c99a45.x: NAMASTE, associated with MoSJE and MoHUA, is implemented by NSKFDC with an allocation of Rs 349.70 crore; TRIFED is not its implementing agency.

n29a1a6764dd.s: Which body purchases minor forest produce at fair prices, runs PDS depots and gives credit to tribal farmers in Andhra Pradesh?
n29a1a6764dd.x: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation (GCC) purchases MFP at fair prices, runs PDS depots and provides credit to tribal farmers.

naefe25539d9.s: The Tribal Sub-Plan, adopted in the Fifth Five Year Plan, originated in:
naefe25539d9.x: The Tribal Sub-Plan originated in 1972 and was adopted in the Fifth Plan; its present form is DAPST.

nded32577314.s: Monitoring of the Tribal Sub-Plan moved from the Planning Commission to the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in:
nded32577314.x: TSP monitoring shifted to MoTA in January 2017; online monitoring now covers the ST component of 41 ministries.

n9f71a8036f8.s: The Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) scheme started in:
n9f71a8036f8.x: EMRS began in 1997-98; its target is 740 schools and Odisha has the highest number of EMRS.

n001922ae092.s: In a Van Dhan Vikas Kendra, at least what share of members must be from Scheduled Tribes?
n001922ae092.x: A Van Dhan Vikas Kendra typically has about 15 SHGs of up to 20 gatherers each, with at least 60% ST members.

n4a72edac4fc.s: Under the Forest Rights Act, 2006, 'nistar' is classified as a/an:
n4a72edac4fc.x: Nistar, grazing, fishing and ownership and disposal of minor forest produce are listed community rights under the FRA.

nfa26ea7946d.s: Raising farm output with improved seeds and fertilisers, planting fruit-bearing trees and other income-raising activities in tribal areas are objectives of:
nfa26ea7946d.x: Agricultural improvement, fruit-bearing plantations and other income-generating activities in tribal areas are objectives of TADP/ITDA.

ne92b0768ba0.s: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes under Article 338A was created by the:
ne92b0768ba0.x: Article 338A was inserted by the 89th Constitutional Amendment, 2003; NCST functions from 19 February 2004 with civil-court powers.

n994a4440d3f.s: PM-AJAY aims at reducing poverty among:
n994a4440d3f.x: PM-AJAY (2021-22, MoSJE) is a 100% central scheme that merged three SC schemes and targets SC poverty, not STs.

nece18fb4aa8.s: The Santhals revere Parasnath Hills, a Jain pilgrimage site, as:
nece18fb4aa8.x: Parasnath Hills are a Jain pilgrimage site and are revered by Santhals as Marang Buru.

nfddc17ddbde.s: The Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence provide free Civil Services coaching to:
nfddc17ddbde.x: The Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence give free Civil Services coaching to SC students in Central Universities.

n16287923e1a.s: G.O. No. 3 (2000), which gave 100% of Scheduled Area teacher posts to local STs, was struck down by the Supreme Court in:
n16287923e1a.x: G.O. No. 3 was issued in 2000 and struck down by the Supreme Court in 2020.

n3216d9e942c.s: Which of the 10 PESA States has only draft PESA rules?
n3216d9e942c.x: Nine of the 10 PESA States, including Andhra Pradesh, have framed PESA rules; Odisha has only draft rules.

n81d1738fdbb.s: The Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan, announced in September 2024, involves how many Ministries?
n81d1738fdbb.x: The Abhiyan involves 17 Ministries and covers about 63,000 tribal villages.

n5c2f2966e99.s: The Koya and Kondh communities oppose which project over land rights, poor compensation and displacement without proper rehabilitation?
n5c2f2966e99.x: The Koya and Kondh communities oppose the Polavaram project over land rights, inadequate compensation and displacement without rehabilitation.

ne15e605912e.s: In August 2026, which Ministry stated that the Forest Rights Act has no provision for Gram Sabha consent for Stage-II forest clearance?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
ne15e605912e.x: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs stated in August 2026 that the FRA has no provision for Gram Sabha consent for Stage-II forest clearance.

nb3de704e8a3.s: Who identified political autonomy, recognition of identity and control over resources as objectives of modern tribal movements?
nb3de704e8a3.x: T. K. Oommen identified political autonomy, identity recognition and control over resources as objectives of modern tribal movements.

n6c0d8c030c6.s: Which case held that the RTE Act does not apply to minority schools?
o: Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India
Unni Krishnan v. State of Andhra Pradesh
Mohini Jain v. State of Karnataka
Pramati Educational and Cultural Trust v. Union of India
n6c0d8c030c6.x: Pramati excluded aided and unaided minority schools from the RTE Act; Bachpan Bachao Andolan dealt with trafficking, circus children and FIRs on missing children.

nindian-society-1-46.s: Which Constitutional Amendment first made education a Fundamental Right?
nindian-society-1-46.x: The 86th Amendment (2002) made education a Fundamental Right.

nindian-society-37-8.s: The CARINGS portal is used for:
o: Tracking of Anganwadi services and nutrition metrics
Child adoption referrals and status tracking
Tracking missing, vulnerable and institutionalised children
Citizen reporting of missing and sighted children
nindian-society-37-8.x: CARINGS handles adoption referrals; Poshan Tracker tracks nutrition, TrackChild traces missing children and Khoya-Paya takes citizen reports.

nfb75491271a.s: Under the RTE Act, an out-of-school child is to be admitted to:
o: A class decided by a screening test
The lowest class of the nearest school
nfb75491271a.x: The RTE Act provides age-appropriate admission for out-of-school children and prohibits screening and capitation fee.

n5ef0a9a5970.s: The duty of parents to provide education to children aged 6–14 years is contained in:
n5ef0a9a5970.x: The parental duty is a Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(k); Article 39(e) protects the tender age of children from abuse.

n8ae3e4f15de.s: The amendment to the RTE Act that permitted detention at Classes V and VIII subject to safeguards was made in:
n8ae3e4f15de.x: The original Act barred detention up to Class VIII; the 2019 amendment allowed detention at Classes V and VIII after examinations and a re-examination opportunity.

n0279d9c33ec.s: Which portal enables citizens to report missing or sighted children?
n0279d9c33ec.x: Khoya-Paya supports citizen reporting of missing or sighted children; TrackChild tracks missing and found children and CARINGS relates to adoption.

n5a4ecded694.s: Under the RTE Act, 2009, what proportion of the members of a School Management Committee must be parents or guardians?
n5a4ecded694.x: Three-fourths of SMC members must be parents or guardians; SMCs are provided under Section 21 in every government and aided school.

nindian-society-1-61.s: Who was the first Chairperson of the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (2007)?
nindian-society-1-61.x: The NCPCR was set up in 2007 with Shanta Sinha as its first chairperson.

naa953c93c00.s: India ratified the two 2000 Optional Protocols to the UNCRC in:
naa953c93c00.x: India ratified the two 2000 Optional Protocols in 2005 but is not a party to the 2011 Communications Procedure Protocol.

nindian-society-49-17.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Child and Adolescent Labour Act – Complete prohibition of employment of children below 14
POCSO Act – Constitution of NCPCR and SCPCRs as statutory bodies
RTE Act – 25% quota in private unaided schools for disadvantaged groups
Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act – Constitution of NCPCR and SCPCRs as statutory bodies
nindian-society-49-17.x: The NCPCR and SCPCRs were set up under the CPCR Act; POCSO is a gender-neutral law punishing child sexual abuse.

nindian-society-46-13.s: Which of the following case–subject pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu – Child labour in hazardous industries
Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India – Child trafficking and child begging
M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu – Consensual same-sex adult relationships
Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India – Human-rights oversight of Child Care Institutions
nindian-society-46-13.x: M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu dealt with hazardous child labour; consensual same-sex relations was the subject of Navtej Johar.

n7095db75872.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about enforcement under the amended child labour law?
o: Offences under the Act are non-cognizable
Imprisonment may range from six months to two years
The fine may range from ₹20,000 to ₹50,000
A Child and Adolescent Labour Rehabilitation Fund is established under the Act
n7095db75872.x: The amendment made offences under the Act cognizable, not non-cognizable.

n483ee8d530e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the age of consent under POCSO?
o: The Standing Committee on Home Affairs (167th Report, 2012) supported retaining 18 years
The Law Commission (283rd Report, 2023) recommended lowering the age of consent
The Law Commission warned that lowering the age could make POCSO a 'paper law'
The Supreme Court in January 2026 urged consideration of a Romeo-Juliet clause
n483ee8d530e.x: The 283rd Law Commission Report warned against lowering the age, saying it could make POCSO a 'paper law'.

nindian-society-43-15.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Justice Pam Rajput Committee – 50% reservation for women in local bodies
Justice J.S. Verma Committee – Introduction of stalking and voyeurism offences
Jaya Jaitly Task Force – Raising women's minimum marriage age to 21 years
Gurupadaswamy Committee – 50% reservation for women in local bodies
nindian-society-43-15.x: The Gurupadaswamy Committee recommended a dual approach to child labour; 50% reservation was recommended by the Pam Rajput Committee.

n767e2d911fc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2016?
o: A child may help the family or family enterprise after school hours
A child may work as an artist in audio-visual entertainment, including circus
The child-artist exception applies only if schooling is not affected
Offences under the Act are cognizable
n767e2d911fc.x: The audio-visual entertainment exception for child artists excludes circus.

nindian-society-43-10.s: Which committee–ministry pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Gurupadaswamy Committee – Ministry of Women and Child Development
Justice Pam Rajput Committee – Ministry of Women and Child Development
Phulrenu Guha Committee – Ministry of Education and Social Welfare
Justice Deepak Verma Committee – Supreme Court of India / Ministry of Women and Child Development
nindian-society-43-10.x: The Gurupadaswamy Committee came under the Ministry of Labour.

n205af3cfd1b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Supreme Court's decision on the Calcutta High Court ruling on adolescent relationships?
o: The Supreme Court set aside the Calcutta High Court ruling
The Supreme Court itself excluded consensual adolescent relationships from POCSO
The Supreme Court used Article 142 for sentencing flexibility
The Calcutta High Court ruling had excluded consensual adolescent relationships from POCSO
n205af3cfd1b.x: The Supreme Court set aside the High Court ruling that had excluded consensual adolescent relationships from POCSO; it did not create such an exclusion itself.

n029562f24ae.s: Mission Vatsalya, the umbrella for child protection from 1 April 2022, is run by which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
n029562f24ae.x: Mission Vatsalya is the Ministry of Women and Child Development's child-protection umbrella, covering CWCs, JJBs and DCPUs.

nf89bdbaa84e.s: Special Training Centres under the National Child Labour Project cater to rescued children of which age group?
nf89bdbaa84e.x: NCLP Special Training Centres serve rescued children aged 9-14 with bridge education, vocational training, mid-day meal and a stipend.

nf9770d5160e.s: The Juvenile Justice (Amendment) Act, 2021 made whom the focal point for implementation of the Act and empowered to decide adoption cases?
o: Chairperson of the Child Welfare Committee
Principal Magistrate of the Juvenile Justice Board
nf9770d5160e.x: The 2021 amendment made the District Magistrate the focal point for implementation and gave the DM power to decide adoption cases.

ne7e7b923452.s: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 retains 18 years as the age of consent under Section:
ne7e7b923452.x: BNS Section 63 retains 18 years as the age of consent.

n55235fc4895.s: Children in Conflict with Law are dealt with by:
o: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
n55235fc4895.x: Children in Conflict with Law come before Juvenile Justice Boards; every district has both a JJB and a CWC, each with at least one woman member.

nindian-society-43-4.s: The Phulrenu Guha Committee dealt with:
nindian-society-43-4.x: The Phulrenu Guha Committee dealt with the status of women; Verma with crimes against women, Gurupadaswamy with child labour and Jaya Jaitly with marriage age.

n8c88c0f4237.s: Under the POCSO Act, consent of a person below ____ years is legally irrelevant.
n8c88c0f4237.x: POCSO fixes the relevant age at 18 years, so apparent consent below 18 is irrelevant.

nb3930cdffe8.s: After a preliminary assessment of a 16–18-year-old accused of a heinous offence, the Juvenile Justice Board may transfer the case to the:
nb3930cdffe8.x: The JJB may transfer the matter to the Children's Court after the preliminary assessment, which does not itself establish guilt.

n01e267fa07b.s: The POCSO Act came into force on:
n01e267fa07b.x: POCSO came into force on 14 November 2012; the 2019 amendment set a 10-year minimum for penetrative sexual assault.

nfba8652cc66.s: Which law widened the concept of trafficking to include sexual exploitation, slavery, servitude, forced labour and organ removal?
nfba8652cc66.x: The Criminal Law Amendment Act, 2013 widened trafficking to cover sexual exploitation, slavery, servitude, forced labour and organ removal.

n712c38f3233.s: Protection of children against exploitation and moral and material abandonment is provided under:
n712c38f3233.x: Article 39(f) guards against exploitation and moral and material abandonment; Article 39(e) protects tender age from abuse.

nindian-society-43-20.s: Which committee, associated with the Supreme Court and the Ministry of Women and Child Development, streamlined adoption processes?
nindian-society-43-20.x: The Justice Deepak Verma Committee simplified adoption and oversaw childcare institutions under the JJ framework.

nindian-society-46-11.s: Which judgement struck down the marital-rape exception in IPC Section 375 for wives below 18?
o: Independent Thought v. Union of India
Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India
Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu
nindian-society-46-11.x: Independent Thought (2017) struck down the exception, holding sex with a girl under 18 is statutory rape even within marriage.

nindian-society-43-8.s: Stalking and voyeurism were introduced as offences on the recommendation of the:
nindian-society-43-8.x: The J.S. Verma Committee (Home Affairs) widened the definition of rape and added stalking and voyeurism.

n82d7f214977.s: The Age of Consent Act, 1891 fixed the age of consent at:
n82d7f214977.x: The IPC 1860 fixed 10 years, the Age of Consent Act 1891 raised it to 12, the 1925 IPC amendment to 14, and POCSO 2012 to 18.

nindian-society-38-7.s: PENCIL is an inter-agency tracking mechanism for:
nindian-society-38-7.x: PENCIL tracks child labour cases by linking Child Labour Committees, police and NGOs for rescue and rehabilitation.

na2836607e9e.s: Which of the following scheme–feature pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Balika Samriddhi Yojana – Cash grant at birth and scholarships for girls of BPL families
Dhanalakshmi – Conditional cash transfer linked with birth registration, immunisation and schooling
Beti Bachao Beti Padhao – Behaviour-change campaign for survival and education of the girl child
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana – Savings scheme with maturity at 15 years
na2836607e9e.x: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana matures at 21 years, not 15.

nf2dd862d2bc.s: Which of the following POSHAN initiative–feature pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Poshan Vatika – ECCE and play-based pedagogy
Poshan Tracker – Real-time monitoring of Anganwadi services
Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi – ECCE and play-based pedagogy
Poshan Pakhwada – Brain development in the first six years
nf2dd862d2bc.x: Poshan Vatika relates to nutrition gardens at Anganwadi centres; ECCE and play-based pedagogy is Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi.

n8e004ff8975.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature of PM POSHAN?
o: Social audit only in selected districts on an optional basis
Additional nutrition in aspirational and high-anaemia districts
Participation of Farmer Producer Organisations and Self-Help Groups
n8e004ff8975.x: Under PM POSHAN, social audit is mandatory in every district, not optional.

nindian-society-37-11.s: Which of the following portal–function pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: PMMVY Soft Portal – DBT verification and cash benefits for pregnant and lactating mothers
Poshan Tracker App – Panic-button distress dispatch
nindian-society-37-11.x: Poshan Tracker monitors nutrition and Anganwadi services in real time; panic-button dispatch is 112 India.

n2972f8fcc88.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Beti Bachao Beti Padhao?
o: It is primarily a behaviour-change campaign
Funds for each district vary with its Sex Ratio at Birth
It provides direct benefit transfers to every girl child
n2972f8fcc88.x: BBBP has no DBT component; it is a behaviour-change campaign with no asset creation.

na94ff47d339.s:
Assertion (A): Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is administered by the Ministry of Finance as a savings scheme.
Reason (R): The Ministry of Women and Child Development is the nodal ministry for BBBP, along with the Health and Education ministries.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
na94ff47d339.x: MWCD is nodal for BBBP with Health and Education; the Ministry of Finance savings scheme is Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana.

nb80478e7544.s: A Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account matures after:
nb80478e7544.x: SSY, under the Ministry of Finance, allows up to two girls per family, deposits of ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh a year, and matures at 21 years.

n0f5bcd76b95.s: The ALIVA model to end child marriage originated in which district of Odisha?
n0f5bcd76b95.x: ALIVA originated in Nayagarh district, Odisha, not Ganjam.

n316c70a00bd.s: Swadhar, which provides shelter to women in difficult circumstances, is now part of:
n316c70a00bd.x: Swadhar now sits inside Shakti Sadan; Ujjawala deals with trafficking and PMUY (MoPNG) gives LPG connections.

n3e07a357ede.s: The nodal ministry for PM POSHAN (the renamed Mid-Day Meal Scheme) is the:
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
n3e07a357ede.x: PM POSHAN is run by the Ministry of Education (Department of School Education and Literacy); MWCD runs ICDS.

ne73bdfe1d31.s: Which of the following was NOT merged into Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 (2021)?
ne73bdfe1d31.x: PM POSHAN is a separate school-meal scheme; Poshan 2.0 merged Anganwadi Services/SNP, POSHAN Abhiyaan and the Scheme for Adolescent Girls.

n323980c9d9c.s: ICDS is now run as Anganwadi Services under:
n323980c9d9c.x: ICDS, a centrally sponsored MWCD scheme implemented by States/UTs, now runs as Anganwadi Services under Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0.

n8f5123a4c73.s: Under ICDS, Supplementary Nutrition is delivered through the:
n8f5123a4c73.x: Supplementary Nutrition is delivered through the Anganwadi Centre, while immunisation, health check-up and referral go through the health system.

na7adf044999.s: Which of the following case–issue pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Jeeja Ghosh v. Union of India – Mandatory accessibility standards under the RPwD Act
Vikash Kumar v. UPSC – Scribe as reasonable accommodation without benchmark disability
Jeeja Ghosh v. Union of India – Deplaning of a woman with cerebral palsy and right to dignity
Rajive Raturi v. Union of India – Mandatory accessibility standards under the RPwD Act
na7adf044999.x: Mandatory accessibility standards were the issue in Rajive Raturi; Jeeja Ghosh concerned deplaning and dignity.

nindian-society-10-7.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995 – First comprehensive disability law
Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992 – Welfare of persons with autism and cerebral palsy
National Trust Act, 1999 – Welfare of persons with autism and cerebral palsy
Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 – Rights-based disability framework
nindian-society-10-7.x: The RCI Act, 1992 covers training of rehabilitation professionals; autism and cerebral palsy come under the National Trust Act, 1999.

nindian-society-37-4.s: Which of the following portal–function pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Sugamya Pustakalaya – Online library with DAISY, audio and Braille formats
PRASHAST App – School-based screening for 21 disabilities
PM-DAKSH Portal – Skill development, vocational training and employment listings
Sugamya Bharat App – School-based screening for 21 disabilities
nindian-society-37-4.x: Sugamya Bharat App takes accessibility complaints on public buildings, transport and infrastructure; school screening is PRASHAST.

nindian-society-1-59.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: First Chief Commissioner for Disabilities – PWD Act, 1995
First National Policy for Persons with Disabilities – 1999
National Trust Act for autism, cerebral palsy and related conditions – 1999
Constitutional basis for disability welfare – DPSPs and equality provisions
nindian-society-1-59.x: The first National Policy for Persons with Disabilities came in 2006; 1999 is the year of the National Trust Act.

ndd5a7c830a0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016?
o: It provides 5% reservation in government jobs and 4% in higher education seats
Benchmark disability means at least 40% of a specified disability
Children with benchmark disabilities get free education from 6 to 18 years
It increased specified disabilities from 7 to 21
ndd5a7c830a0.x: The figures are reversed: the Act gives 4% reservation in government jobs and 5% in higher education.

n5935361ae46.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding inclusive education for children with disabilities in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Inclusive education assistance is Rs 3,500 per child with special needs
AP Samagra Shiksha won the national award for Best State in implementing the RPwD Act for 2024-25
Samagra Shiksha's inclusive component targets exclusive education of gifted children
n5935361ae46.x: Samagra Shiksha's inclusive component covers assessment, aids, assistive technology and therapy; exclusive education of gifted children is not its target.

nccc2d7d926d.s: The RPwD Act, 2016 increased the number of specified disabilities from 7 to:
nccc2d7d926d.x: The Act raised specified disabilities from 7 to 21, including autism, acid attack victims and sickle cell disease, and lets the Centre add more.

nfb1de788fe8.s: Which of the following is NOT a service under Samagra Shiksha's inclusive education component for RPwD-listed disabilities?
nfb1de788fe8.x: Samagra Shiksha covers assessment, aids, assistive technology and therapy for children with disabilities, not exclusive education of gifted children.

ne4ba7139b6a.s: The three verticals of the Accessible India Campaign are built environment, transport and:
ne4ba7139b6a.x: The verticals are built environment, transport and ICT; accessible booths and Braille-enabled EVMs are accessible-election measures, not a vertical.

ne5b39607a56.s: The Central Rehabilitation Register is maintained by the:
o: Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities
ne5b39607a56.x: The Rehabilitation Council of India maintains the Central Rehabilitation Register; the National Trust covers autism, cerebral palsy and related conditions.

n0c61374f10d.s: Andhra Pradesh's Divyang Shakti (2026) provides persons with disabilities:
n0c61374f10d.x: Divyang Shakti gives 100% free APSRTC bus travel to persons with disabilities; concessional self-employment loans are associated with NDFDC.

n72c4c36fb20.s: SVNIRTAR, a national institute for persons with disabilities, is located at:
n72c4c36fb20.x: SVNIRTAR is at Cuttack; Dehradun hosts the visual-disability institute and NIEPID is at Secunderabad.

n41d34912ac2.s: 'Relief of the disabled and unemployable' is an entry in the:
n41d34912ac2.x: State List Entry 9 concerns relief of the disabled and unemployable; Article 41 covers public assistance in disablement.

n2efa2a0dd36.s: In March 2026, the Supreme Court held that the 40% threshold for benchmark disability is a:
o: Ceiling applicable only to Group A posts
Limit applicable only to locomotor disability
n2efa2a0dd36.x: The Court treated 40% as a floor, not a ceiling, with suitability judged by functional ability and reasonable accommodation.

nindian-society-45-15.s: Which case held that the scribe facility cannot be restricted only to persons with benchmark disabilities?
o: Jeeja Ghosh v. Union of India
Rajive Raturi v. Union of India
Disabled Rights Group v. Union of India
nindian-society-45-15.x: Vikash Kumar v. UPSC (2021) treated reasonable accommodation as part of equality, so scribes cannot be limited to benchmark disabilities.

ncf78358c4fe.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007?
o: Its 2019 Amendment Bill, removing the maintenance ceiling, was enacted by Parliament
Abandoning a senior citizen may attract imprisonment up to three months and/or a fine up to ₹5,000
At least one old-age home is contemplated in every district
It is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
ncf78358c4fe.x: The 2019 Amendment Bill proposed removing the maintenance cap but was not passed.

nc1d355ee476.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about policies for the elderly?
o: The National Policy on Older Persons, 1999 was framed by MoSJE
The National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011 gives special focus to elderly women
The National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly was launched by MoSJE
The National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011 emphasises ageing in place
nc1d355ee476.x: NPHCE was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in 2010-11, not MoSJE.

nee8016bfaf7.s:
Assertion (A): The Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens (Amendment) Bill, 2019 proposed covering in-laws and grandchildren.
Reason (R): The Bill was enacted as an Act of Parliament.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nee8016bfaf7.x: The Bill proposed removing the Rs 10,000 cap and covering in-laws and grandchildren, but it was not passed.

n8c13ec53974.s: Under the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPOP), a component of AVYAY, eligible NGOs may get up to what share of project cost?
n8c13ec53974.x: IPOP can fund up to 90 per cent of project cost for old-age homes, day-care centres and mobile medicare units.

nd8fe7b4b1d1.s: IGNOAPS, a component of the National Social Assistance Programme, is administered by the:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nd8fe7b4b1d1.x: IGNOAPS is under NSAP and the Ministry of Rural Development; its assistance has been frozen at Rs 200 since 2007.

n0ac52023bd4.s: The Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana for BPL senior citizens is funded from the:
n0ac52023bd4.x: The scheme is funded from the Senior Citizens' Welfare Fund and requires at least 30 per cent women beneficiaries in each district.

n01c013bf1fc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding the debate on population control?
o: Population control is considered necessary for environmental protection
Southern States that controlled population may lose relative representation and financial advantages
Population carries 40–50% weight in Finance Commission formulas
Delimitation could cost the southern States 8–10 seats
n01c013bf1fc.x: Population carries 15–25% weight in Finance Commission formulas, not 40–50%.

nd7d5cdcb734.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: India – First national family planning programme
Kerala – First Senior Citizens' Welfare Department
Andhra Pradesh – Draft Population Management Policy
nd7d5cdcb734.x: The draft Population Management Policy is associated with Andhra Pradesh; Kerala was first with the senior-citizens framework.

n1142cc17f04.s:
Assertion (A): According to SRS 2024, India's TFR has stayed below the replacement level of 2.1 for the fifth year.
Reason (R): Bihar recorded the lowest TFR among States.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1142cc17f04.x: India's TFR (1.9) is below 2.1 for the fifth year, but Delhi (1.2) is lowest; Bihar is the highest-fertility State.

naddb28f581f.s: As per Census 2011, India's decadal population growth rate for 2001-11 was:
naddb28f581f.x: Decadal growth in 2001-11 was 17.7%; India's population was about 121.09 crore, 68.9% of it rural.

na7c70af6f33.s: In Javed v. State of Haryana (2003), the Supreme Court:
o: Abolished two-child norms for local elections across India
Ruled only on the dependency ratio
na7c70af6f33.x: In Javed v. State of Haryana (2003), the Supreme Court upheld Haryana's two-child norm.

nee913050b66.s: In the history of India's population growth, the year 1921 is known as the:
o: Start of high but slowing growth
nee913050b66.x: After decline in 1911–1921 came the Great Divide in 1921, the explosion of 1961–1971 and high but slowing growth in 1981–2011.

n83b38c38d82.s: About how many new working-age people does India need jobs for every year?
n83b38c38d82.x: About 9.7 million new working-age people enter each year; the demographic dividend pays off only if they are employed.

na3b7ae0516c.s: About what percentage of elderly persons in India have no pension?
na3b7ae0516c.x: About 78% of the elderly have no pension and about 70% depend on others.

n7765a03a70a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2026 amendment to the transgender persons law?
o: The District Magistrate issues the certificate on the recommendation of a designated medical board
Self-perceived identity continues to be expressly included without restriction
The definition is limited to specified socio-cultural identities, intersex variations and persons forced to present as transgender
Kidnapping and forcing a person to present as transgender were added as offences
n7765a03a70a.x: The amendment excludes self-perceived identity and omits Section 4(2).

nedab276c32d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the definition of a transgender person under the 2019 Act?
o: It excludes persons with intersex variations
It includes trans men and trans women
It includes socio-cultural identities such as kinner, hijra, aravani and jogta
nedab276c32d.x: The 2019 definition includes persons with intersex variations, along with trans men and women, genderqueer persons and the listed socio-cultural identities.

n60260cc08a4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NALSA v. Union of India?
o: It held that gender identity must be decided by biological examination and State verification
It recognised transgender persons as the third gender
It extended Articles 14, 15, 16, 19(1)(a) and 21 to transgender persons
n60260cc08a4.x: NALSA held that gender identity is self-determined, not dependent on biology or State verification.

n739c6e65c31.s:
Assertion (A): NALSA v. Union of India, delivered on 15 April 2014 by Justices K.S. Radhakrishnan and A.K. Sikri, recognised transgender persons' gender identity.
Reason (R): The judgment held that gender identity must be decided by biological examination and State verification.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n739c6e65c31.x: The date and bench are correct, but NALSA held gender identity is self-determined, not decided by biology or State verification.

n6236893126a.s: The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 is administered by the:
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
n6236893126a.x: The Act (in force from 10 January 2020) is administered by MoSJE, and its National Council is chaired by the Union Social Justice Minister.

nac766a458da.s: Under the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, the certificate of identity is issued by the:
nac766a458da.x: The District Magistrate issues the certificate (a revised one after surgery); the National Council only advises and monitors policy.

nce7ebe1cd75.s: The Rights of Transgender Persons Bill, 2014, a private member's Bill, was passed by the Rajya Sabha in:
nce7ebe1cd75.x: It passed the Rajya Sabha in April 2015, the first private member's Bill passed there in over four decades, but was not passed by the Lok Sabha.

nff2ca253735.s: Invalidity and old-age pensions are listed in:
nff2ca253735.x: Invalidity and old-age pensions are in Concurrent List Entry 24, not State List Entry 9; NSAP rests on Articles 41 and 42.

n3657f0b4a2d.s: The goal of the SMILE scheme, launched by MoSJE in 2022, is:
n3657f0b4a2d.x: SMILE, an umbrella Central Sector scheme, aims at a begging-free India, 'Bhiksha Vritti Mukt Bharat'.

n952e900fff1.s: Which of the following case–holding pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: In re Kerala Education Bill – State may regulate standards without destroying minority character
St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi – Aided minority college may prefer its own community up to 50 per cent of seats
T.M.A. Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka – State cannot impose reservation on unaided professional institutions
P.A. Inamdar v. State of Maharashtra – State cannot impose reservation on unaided professional institutions
n952e900fff1.x: T.M.A. Pai made the State the unit for determining minority status; the bar on reservation in unaided institutions is P.A. Inamdar.

n8899bfab325.s: Which of the following Article–provision pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Article 350A – Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities
Article 350 – Representation for grievances in any language used in the Union or a State
Article 347 – Recognition of a language spoken by a substantial part of a State
Article 350B – Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities
n8899bfab325.x: Article 350A provides for mother-tongue instruction at the primary stage; the Special Officer is under Article 350B.

nindian-society-1-55.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Article 29 – Protection of a section's distinct language, script or culture
Article 30 – Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions
Ranganath Misra Commission – First Chairman of the National Commission for Minorities
Justice Mohammed Sardar Ali Khan – First Chairman of the National Commission for Minorities
nindian-society-1-55.x: Justice Mohammed Sardar Ali Khan was the first NCM chairman; the Ranganath Misra Commission studied religious and linguistic minorities.

n79b51d72c44.s:
Assertion (A): Not all seven members of the National Commission for Minorities need belong to minority communities.
Reason (R): Only five of the seven members, including the Chairperson, must be from minority communities.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n79b51d72c44.x: The NCM has a Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and five Members; since only five must be from minorities, all seven need not be.

nd7702fbc60a.s:
Assertion (A): The Supreme Court's interim order of September 2025 stayed the five-years-practising-Islam condition in the Waqf (Amendment) Act.
Reason (R): The same order accepted the change applying the Limitation Act.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd7702fbc60a.x: The order stayed the five-year condition and the Collector's power and accepted the Limitation Act change; the two holdings are separate, so R does not explain A.

nae84214ff59.s: Which provision bars denial of admission to State-maintained or State-aided educational institutions on grounds only of religion, race, caste or language?
nae84214ff59.x: Article 29(2) bars such denial; Article 29(1) protects the language, script or culture of any distinct section of citizens.

nee61d2ecbac.s: The PM's New 15 Point Programme for the Welfare of Minorities was introduced in:
nee61d2ecbac.x: The programme, introduced in 2006, covers education, jobs, living conditions, prevention of communal violence and earmarked outlays.

n0ca6516d8a6.s: T.M.A. Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka (2002) was decided by a Bench of how many judges?
n0ca6516d8a6.x: An 11-judge Bench made the State the unit for minority status and allowed regulation, but not control, of minority institutions.

n376dc9eaae7.s: The National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) was established in:
n376dc9eaae7.x: NSFDC came in 1989 for SCs, NBCFDC in 1992 for Backward Classes and NSTFDC in 2001 for STs; NMDFC serves minorities.

nb74965aff79.s: Which Article bars the State from discriminating against minority educational institutions in granting aid?
nb74965aff79.x: Under Article 30 the State cannot discriminate against minority institutions in aid; it may regulate standards without destroying minority character.

nf5a8ac84f8d.s: The SEED scheme, launched in 2022, has a stated outlay of:
nf5a8ac84f8d.x: SEED (2022) has an outlay of Rs 200 crore and covers coaching, health insurance, livelihoods and housing for incomes below Rs 2.5 lakh.

nd5b5700e8c8.s: PM VIKAS, a Central Sector scheme of 2022 merging five minority schemes, stands for:
o: Pradhan Mantri Vikas Aur Kaushal Samvardhan
Pradhan Mantri Virasat Aur Kala Sanrakshan
nd5b5700e8c8.x: PM VIKAS means Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan; it merges five schemes and runs until 2025-26.

n51aae9249f2.s: Under the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025, all waqf properties were to be placed on a central portal within:
n51aae9249f2.x: The 2025 amendment required waqf properties on a central portal within six months; the UMEED portal was launched in June 2025.

nee0f554912b.s: The Chairperson and members of the National Commission for Minorities are appointed by the:
nee0f554912b.x: NCM members are appointed by the Central Government, not the President; the statutory NCM dates from the 1992 Act, first constituted in 1993.

nb4e49b60844.s: The Minorities Commission became a statutory body under the NCM Act in:
nb4e49b60844.x: The non-statutory Commission came in 1978, the NCM Act in 1992, the first statutory Commission in 1993 and the Vice-Chairperson in 1995.

n1a8a33cac6e.s: What percentage of PM-YASASVI slots is earmarked for girls?
n1a8a33cac6e.x: PM-YASASVI reserves 30 percent of slots for girls and follows a 60:40 cost-sharing ratio.

nbb06400c0ef.s: Andhra Pradesh's G.O. 1065 (August 2026) provides what BC reservation in urban local body polls?
nbb06400c0ef.x: G.O. 1065 gives 33.33% BC reservation in ULB polls; AP's 138 BC communities are in Groups A-E.

nd22302fc6ef.s: The National Commission for Safai Karamcharis Act, 1993 lapsed in:
nd22302fc6ef.x: The Act lapsed in 2004; the NCSK continues as a non-statutory body with tenure extended by resolution.

ne4b6733feb9.s: Jains were notified as a minority community in:
ne4b6733feb9.x: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists and Parsis were notified in 1993; Jains were added in 2014.

n76da84480c6.s: Articles 350A and 350B were inserted by the:
n76da84480c6.x: The 7th Amendment, 1956, linked to States reorganisation, inserted Articles 350A and 350B.

n9179e707223.s: The Wakf (Amendment) Act, 2013 enabled which body to direct State Waqf Boards?
n9179e707223.x: The 2013 amendment let the Central Waqf Council direct State Boards and barred sale, gift, mortgage, exchange and transfer of waqf property.

n1922440f59d.s: For the purposes of the National Commission for Minorities Act, a community is a minority when it is:
o: Defined as such in the Act
n1922440f59d.x: The NCM Act does not define 'minority'; a community notified by the Centre is a minority for the Act, though States may notify their own for State purposes.

n2591cff8610.s: Under the PM's New 15 Point Programme, about what share of targets and outlays in selected schemes is earmarked for minorities?
n2591cff8610.x: The programme earmarks about 15 percent of targets and outlays in selected schemes, aims to prevent communal riots and is monitored by review committees.

na102af2ad77.s: The Idate Commission found about how many Denotified Tribes (DNTs) that had never been classified?
na102af2ad77.x: About 267-268 DNTs had never been classified, while about 1,200 were already in SC, ST or OBC lists.

nce1507edb61.s: The nodal ministry for PM Vishwakarma is the:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nce1507edb61.x: MSME is the nodal ministry; MSDE and the Department of Financial Services are also involved in implementation.

n1a6dbaef0d4.s: While inquiring into complaints, the National Commission for Minorities has powers similar to those of a:
n1a6dbaef0d4.x: The NCM has civil-court-like powers such as summoning witnesses and calling for records; it cannot impose criminal sentences.

nad38df64b41.s: The National Commission for Minority Educational Institutions was established under an Act of:
nad38df64b41.x: The NCMEI is associated with the 2004 Act; statutory State Minority Commissions exist in 19 States/UTs, including Andhra Pradesh.

n5a94c4c931a.s: After T.M.A. Pai Foundation (2002), minority status is decided with reference to the population position in the:
n5a94c4c931a.x: The State, not the whole of India, is the unit for deciding minority status; minority rights are not absolute and may be regulated.

nece167263bd.s: The Sachar Committee, set up in 2005 and chaired by Justice Rajinder Sachar, submitted its report in:
nece167263bd.x: The Sachar Committee was set up by the Prime Minister in 2005 and submitted its report in November 2006.

nf4037eaec59.s: The National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) functions under the:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nf4037eaec59.x: NBCFDC (1992) is under MoSJE; NMDFC is under the Ministry of Minority Affairs, and both lend through State Channelising Agencies.

n01a7f0f63ff.s: The NBCFDC's New Swarnima scheme is meant for:
n01a7f0f63ff.x: New Swarnima is for women and Saksham for young professionals; Virasat loans for artisans are associated with NMDFC.

n416adef5d2c.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Industrial Relations Code, prior government permission for layoff, retrenchment and closure is needed only for establishments with 300 or more workers.
Reason (R): The contract labour threshold was raised from 20 to 50 workers.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n416adef5d2c.x: The permission threshold rose from 100 to 300 and the contract labour threshold from 20 to 50; these are separate changes, so R does not explain A.

n9d1548615bb.s: Under the Industrial Relations Code, fixed-term workers become eligible for gratuity after:
n9d1548615bb.x: Fixed-term workers get the same wages and benefits as permanent workers and gratuity after one year.

n2abac1f3372.s: The e-Shram portal provides every registered unorganised worker with a 12-digit:
n2abac1f3372.x: e-Shram, India's first Aadhaar-seeded national database of unorganised workers, gives each worker a 12-digit UAN.

n705aa959c2d.s: The Swavalamban scheme for unorganised workers joining NPS-Lite was replaced in 2015 by:
n705aa959c2d.x: Swavalamban (2010) was replaced by the Atal Pension Yojana in 2015; Ashraya Bima Yojana (2001, LIC) was for workers who lost jobs.

n6e4156892ec.s: The entry age for PM-SYM, which assures ₹3,000 a month from age 60, is:
n6e4156892ec.x: PM-SYM entry age is 18-40 (18-50 is PMJJBY); it covers unorganised workers earning up to ₹15,000 a month.

n05138a007e1.s: The Atal Pension Yojana (2015) is administered by:
n05138a007e1.x: APY gives a guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 from age 60 and is run by PFRDA.

n63b0b98dafb.s: The Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY), launched in 2008 for BPL families, provided hospitalisation cover of:
n63b0b98dafb.x: RSBY (2008) gave BPL families ₹30,000 hospitalisation cover and was later subsumed in AB-PMJAY.

n7a9515fe888.s: Under the Social Security framework, gig workers can register from the age of:
n7a9515fe888.x: Gig workers can register from 16, with National and State Social Security Boards; registration does not confer employee status or a minimum wage.

n554395258f7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026?
o: Sponsored listings need not be disclosed if the product is offered at a reduced price
E-commerce entities must join the National Consumer Helpline convergence process
Search results must not be manipulated
The prior price shown with a discount must be the lowest price in the preceding 30 days
n554395258f7.x: Sponsored listings must be clearly disclosed; there is no reduced-price exception.

n79b28e9930f.s:
Assertion (A): The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 impose identical liabilities on marketplace and inventory entities.
Reason (R): An inventory entity owns the goods or services that it sells through the platform.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n79b28e9930f.x: The Rules distinguish the liabilities of the two: a marketplace entity is a platform intermediary, whereas an inventory entity owns the goods it sells.

n779ad2c2ad0.s: National Consumer Day in India is observed on:
n779ad2c2ad0.x: National Consumer Day is 24 December; World Consumer Rights Day is 15 March.

n04b4b9cd2f2.s: An appeal against an order of a State Consumer Commission lies to the National Commission within:
n04b4b9cd2f2.x: State to National is within 30 days; District to State is within 45 days and National to Supreme Court within 30 days.

n4e44aad7b8d.s: Which of the following bodies was introduced by the Consumer Protection Act, 2019?
n4e44aad7b8d.x: The 2019 Act introduced the CCPA, along with product liability, e-commerce rules and penalties for adulterated goods; the NCDRC dates from 1988.

n2cdfec7232f.s: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, consumer mediation cells are attached to:
n2cdfec7232f.x: Mediation cells are attached to the District, State and National Consumer Commissions, not High Courts.

n036e648bbee.s: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 1986, the District, State and National Commissions were called:
n036e648bbee.x: They were Consumer Forums under the 1986 Act; they are quasi-judicial bodies, not ordinary civil courts under the CPC.

n9f39214c1aa.s: The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission was set up in:
n9f39214c1aa.x: The NCDRC was set up in 1988; its original orders are appealable to the Supreme Court within 30 days.

n4369bfae700.s: Which body can inquire into violations of consumer rights, file class-action complaints and impose penalties?
n4369bfae700.x: The CCPA can inquire into violations, order recalls and refunds, file class-action complaints and impose penalties.

nb620a400c78.s: The Central Consumer Protection Authority came into existence on:
nb620a400c78.x: The CCPA came into existence on 24 July 2020; 24 December is National Consumer Day.

n9eb2c434dd4.s:
Assertion (A): The service chiefs may attend meetings of the Cabinet Committee on Security as invitees.
Reason (R): The service chiefs are permanent members of the Committee in place of the Defence Minister.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n9eb2c434dd4.x: The NSA, Cabinet Secretary and service chiefs attend as invitees; the Defence Minister is a member and is not replaced by the service chiefs.

n487858c7287.s: Setting up Bhilai with the USSR and Rourkela with West Germany illustrates which determinant of India's foreign policy?
n487858c7287.x: Taking aid and technology from both blocs reflects the economy as a determinant; Himalayan frontiers reflect geography.

nce08ad40f97.s: India's demand for UNSC reform is summed up in its call for:
nce08ad40f97.x: India seeks UNSC reform and advocates 'reformed multilateralism', strengthening rather than weakening multilateral bodies.

n4a24f6ed30c.s: Strategic autonomy in India's foreign policy is associated with:
n4a24f6ed30c.x: Nehruvian idealism, the Indira and Gujral Doctrines belong to individual leaders, while strategic autonomy is associated with all PMs since 1947.

nc20dab3bd76.s: Foreign affairs is listed in which entry of the Union List?
nc20dab3bd76.x: Entry 10 is foreign affairs; Entry 14 treaties, Entry 15 war and peace, and Entries 11–13 diplomatic representation and the UN.

nc51946caeb8.s: Kwame Nkrumah, a founding leader of the Non-Aligned Movement, belonged to:
nc51946caeb8.x: Nkrumah was associated with Ghana, Nasser with Egypt, Tito with Yugoslavia and Nehru with India.

n9562c674650.s: Nehru's Tribal Panchsheel (1952) was drafted with:
n9562c674650.x: Nehru's Tribal Panchsheel was drafted with Verrier Elwin in 1952 and dealt with tribal policy, unlike the international Panchsheel.

nb3d82d9378c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the milestones of the Indo-US civil nuclear deal?
o: A joint statement was issued in 2005
The Hyde Act was enacted in 2008
The NSG waiver was granted on 6 September 2008
The 123 Agreement was signed in October 2008
nb3d82d9378c.x: The Hyde Act was enacted in 2006, not 2008.

n41cea49e731.s: Which of the following phase–label pairs of India's foreign policy is INCORRECTLY matched?
n41cea49e731.x: 1991-98 was the phase of safeguarding strategic autonomy after the USSR's collapse; energetic engagement is the label for 2014 onwards.

nd1c3199a5a1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the aftermath of Pokhran-II (1998)?
o: The Jaswant Singh–Strobe Talbott talks preceded the nuclear tests
The US imposed sanctions under the Glenn Amendment
No First Use was announced by the Vajpayee government and formalised in 2003
nd1c3199a5a1.x: The Singh–Talbott talks followed the tests and sanctions; they did not precede them.

n9f855407908.s: Which of the following did NOT belong to the 1962–1971 phase of realism and recovery in India's foreign policy?
o: Refusal to sign the NPT in 1968
n9f855407908.x: The NSG waiver came in 2008; the other three belong to the 1962–1971 phase.

n53311257ee1.s: The Indo-Soviet Treaty of Peace, Friendship and Cooperation (9 August 1971) was concluded for:
n53311257ee1.x: The treaty was for 20 years and countered the US-China-Pakistan axis during the Bangladesh crisis.

n25a15458232.s: The 'Voice of Global South' initiative is associated with:
n25a15458232.x: Voice of Global South is associated with Narendra Modi; Gujral Doctrine with Gujral, Pokhran-II with Vajpayee and the nuclear deal with Manmohan Singh.

naf3e61f9ec1.x: India held the Presidency from December 2022 to November 2023; the African Union became a permanent member and the theme was 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'.

n8ff7f9c69da.s: On reform of the United Nations, the BRICS New Delhi Declaration, 2026:
n8ff7f9c69da.x: The Declaration backed UN reform, criticised unilateral sanctions and was likened to India's non-aligned past.

ne74acdb5bd7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Tashkent Declaration (January 1966)?
o: It was mediated by the Soviet Union, with Kosygin playing a key role
It converted the ceasefire line into the Line of Control
It provided for troop withdrawal and return of prisoners of war
ne74acdb5bd7.x: The ceasefire line became the LoC under the Simla Agreement, 1972, not under Tashkent.

nd18e47b8c03.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MFN status between India and Pakistan?
o: India granted MFN status to Pakistan in 1996
India withdrew it in February 2019 after Pulwama
Pakistan never reciprocated MFN status to India
India imposed a 100% customs duty on Pakistani goods after withdrawal
nd18e47b8c03.x: The customs duty imposed was 200%, not 100%.

nd2196a31777.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indus Waters Treaty and India's current position?
o: The Treaty is presently in abeyance
India has accepted the Permanent Court of Arbitration ruling
India is seeking to renegotiate the Treaty
Ravi, Beas and Sutlej are allocated to India for unrestricted use
nd2196a31777.x: India has rejected, not accepted, the PCA ruling.

ndf2e87a1c9b.s:
Assertion (A): India may use the western rivers for domestic use, agriculture and run-of-river hydropower, subject to treaty criteria.
Reason (R): The Indus, Jhelum and Chenab are allocated to Pakistan under the Indus Waters Treaty.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ndf2e87a1c9b.x: Both are true: the western rivers go to Pakistan, yet India keeps limited rights over them; the allocation does not explain those rights.

n5f534cedabd.s: The Simla Agreement (2 July 1972) was signed by Indira Gandhi and:
n5f534cedabd.x: Indira Gandhi and Z.A. Bhutto signed it; it committed both sides to bilateral settlement and turned the ceasefire line into the LoC.

nfb65a221397.s: The India–Pakistan agreement on the Kartarpur Corridor was signed in:
nfb65a221397.x: The agreement was signed in October 2019, giving visa-free access from Dera Baba Nanak to Gurdwara Darbar Sahib, Kartarpur.

n17eb5c62c9d.s: In January 1948, India referred the Kashmir issue to the UN Security Council under which Article of the UN Charter?
n17eb5c62c9d.x: Nehru referred it under Article 35 of the UN Charter on 1 January 1948; UNSC Resolution 47 followed in 1948.

n9ea21e26b27.s: The Agra Summit of July 2001, which ended without a joint declaration, was held between Atal Bihari Vajpayee and:
n9ea21e26b27.x: The Agra Summit was between Vajpayee and Musharraf and ended without a joint declaration.

n0456880e35c.s: Which subject was NOT ceded to India under the Instrument of Accession signed by Maharaja Hari Singh?
n0456880e35c.x: The Instrument (26 October 1947) ceded only defence, external affairs and communications; land revenue stayed with the State.

n83aa05824f2.s: The UNSC 1267 sanctions committee deals with:
n83aa05824f2.x: The 1267 committee lists ISIL/Al-Qaida-linked terrorists and entities for asset freezes and travel bans.

nf7849de7180.s: The Samjhauta Express between Attari and Lahore was started in:
nf7849de7180.x: It began in 1976 after the Simla Agreement and was bombed in 2007.

naf4105c2929.s: The Indus Waters Treaty gives India about what share of the waters?
naf4105c2929.x: India gets about 20% of the waters, and the Treaty is criticised for lacking aquifer and drought clauses.

na3f4eb444c8.s: India's military response in the 1999 Kargil conflict was called:
na3f4eb444c8.x: India's response was Operation Vijay; Kargil was the first war between nuclear-armed states, and Pakistan withdrew under US pressure.

na09dbfba611.s: The India–Pakistan Composite Dialogue, agreed in 1997, was resumed in:
na09dbfba611.x: It resumed in 2004 (Agra 2001 ended without a declaration) and was broken off after 26/11.

nf0583adf5de.s: The Supreme Court upheld the abrogation of Article 370 in:
nf0583adf5de.x: Article 370 was abrogated on 5 August 2019 and the Supreme Court upheld it in December 2023.

n17a6af78ead.s: The Indus Waters Treaty (Karachi, 1960), brokered by the World Bank, was signed by Ayub Khan and:
n17a6af78ead.x: Nehru and Ayub Khan signed the Treaty; Shastri and Ayub Khan were the Tashkent pair.

n64277d51c99.s: The attack on the Indian Parliament took place in:
n64277d51c99.x: The Parliament attack was in 2001, followed by Mumbai 26/11 (2008), Uri (2016) and Pulwama (2019).

n6f74cf854dc.s: The Karachi Agreement between India and Pakistan was signed in:
n6f74cf854dc.x: The Karachi Agreement was in 1949, followed by Tashkent (1966), Lahore (1999) and Agra (2001).

n90af2ffd53d.s: Which of the following India–China border mechanism pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: 1996 – Agreement on Confidence-Building Measures in the Military Field
2003 – Declaration on Principles and appointment of Special Representatives
2012 – Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination
n90af2ffd53d.x: The Border Defence Cooperation Agreement was signed in 2013, not 2005.

n94fe2160129.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding recent India–China relations?
o: India holds that relations can become normal even if the border remains unsettled and tense
The 25th round of Special Representatives' talks was held in Beijing in August 2026
Ten PLA brigades were reported to remain on the LAC
The Special Representatives mechanism dates from 2003
n94fe2160129.x: India's stated position is that relations cannot be normal until the border is peaceful.

nde65473562e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the sectors of the Line of Actual Control?
o: The Western sector comprises Ladakh and includes Aksai Chin
The Middle sector comprises Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand
The Middle sector is the most contested sector
The Eastern sector comprises Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh and is associated with the McMahon Line
nde65473562e.x: The Middle sector is the least contested sector of the LAC.

n733198a945a.s:
Assertion (A): The 25th round of India–China Special Representatives' talks (August 2026) issued an eight-point outcome document to improve understanding of the LAC.
Reason (R): The 25th round was held in New Delhi.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n733198a945a.x: The 25th round did issue the eight-point document, but it was held in Beijing, not New Delhi; the 24th round (August 2025) was in New Delhi.

n50d6053cac4.s: India and China have flood-season hydrological data MoUs for the Brahmaputra and the:
n50d6053cac4.x: The flood-season data MoUs cover the Brahmaputra and Sutlej; the Expert Level Mechanism deals with trans-border rivers.

n7e156a6f8b0.s: India recognised the People's Republic of China on:
n7e156a6f8b0.x: India recognised the PRC on 30 December 1949 and established diplomatic ties on 1 April 1950, as the first non-socialist-bloc country to do so.

nc52010c4e11.s: The India–China Strategic Economic Dialogue was set up in:
nc52010c4e11.x: The SED was set up in 2010 and held six rounds (2011-2019); 2013 is the BRI launch year.

na88545e0728.s: Press Note 3 of 2020 requires government approval for FDI from:
o: Countries sharing a land border with India
Countries without a tax treaty with India
na88545e0728.x: Press Note 3 requires government approval for FDI from countries sharing a land border with India; it does not ban such investment.

naf274c49313.x: Kyaukphyu is in Myanmar; Hambantota is in Sri Lanka, Gwadar in Pakistan and Chittagong in Bangladesh.

nccf26f3d356.s: Nathu La in Sikkim was reopened for border trade in:
nccf26f3d356.x: Nathu La reopened for trade in 2006; the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra resumed via Lipulekh and Nathu La.

n9eb5e1b2821.s: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, of which India is a founding member, is headquartered in:
n9eb5e1b2821.x: The AIIB is headquartered in Beijing, not New Delhi, and India is a founding member.

nb7c69b587fc.s: The India–China standoff at Doklam took place in:
nb7c69b587fc.x: Sumdorong Chu was in 1986-87, Depsang 2013, Doklam 2017 and Galwan 2020.

nd9209d7e10f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's connectivity projects with neighbours?
o: The India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway connects Moreh (Manipur) with Mae Sot
The Akhaura-Agartala rail link connects Tripura through Bangladesh
Greater Male Connectivity is an undersea tunnel linking Male with Sri Lanka
Broad-gauge cross-border rail lines with Nepal are under construction
nd9209d7e10f.x: Greater Male Connectivity is a bridge-causeway linking Male to nearby Maldivian islands, not a tunnel to Sri Lanka.

n9ce5c4f13ee.s: Which of the following was NOT part of the Indo-Sri Lanka Accord of 1987?
o: Merger of the Northern and Eastern provinces
n9ce5c4f13ee.x: India banned the LTTE only in 1992, after Rajiv Gandhi's assassination in 1991; it was not part of the Accord.

n0dd0bb50b43.s:
Assertion (A): Nepal's first Constituent Assembly abolished the monarchy on 28 May 2008.
Reason (R): Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda' was the first President of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0dd0bb50b43.x: The monarchy was abolished on 28 May 2008, but Prachanda was the first Prime Minister; the first President was Ram Baran Yadav.

na96ad6a48d7.s: Nepal's hydropower potential is estimated at about:
na96ad6a48d7.x: Nepal's hydropower potential is put at 83,000 MW; the first trilateral power deal had Nepal supplying Bangladesh through the Indian grid.

nc0dea5b28b2.s: The 'India Out' campaign is associated with:
nc0dea5b28b2.x: India Out is a Maldives issue; Teesta concerns Bangladesh, Rohingya Myanmar/Bangladesh and Doklam Bhutan.

n41e432f6171.s: Among the following, which country shares the longest border with India?
n41e432f6171.x: Bangladesh shares 4,096.7 km with India, China 3,488 km, Nepal 1,751 km and Bhutan 699 km.

n3059b3351d6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's maritime visions?
o: SAGAR stands for Security and Growth for All in the Region
SAGAR was announced in Sri Lanka in 2015
MAHASAGAR (2025) stands for Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions
SHANTI was announced on 13 July 2026 by EAM Jaishankar
n3059b3351d6.x: SAGAR (2015) and MAHASAGAR (2025) were both announced in Mauritius, not Sri Lanka.

n54828b1999e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's Look East and Act East policies?
o: Look East was launched in the early 1990s under P.V. Narasimha Rao
Look East was originally economic, focused on trade, investment and AIFTA with ASEAN
Act East was launched in 2014 at a SAARC Summit
Act East was later extended to political, strategic and cultural fields
n54828b1999e.x: Act East was launched in 2014 at the East Asia Summit in Myanmar under PM Modi, not at a SAARC Summit.

na80dd6e1bb8.s:
Assertion (A): Chabahar port gives India access to Afghanistan, Central Asia and the INSTC while bypassing Pakistan.
Reason (R): In 2026, the USA extended India's Chabahar sanctions waiver.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
na80dd6e1bb8.x: Chabahar, in Iran on the Gulf of Oman, is India's gateway bypassing Pakistan, but in 2026 the USA ended, not extended, India's waiver.

n3d2cce754cc.s: The Act East Policy was initially conceived as a/an ____ policy.
n3d2cce754cc.x: Act East began as an economic policy and was later extended to political, strategic and cultural fields with an Indo-Pacific orientation.

nf0d2d22c7e8.s: PM Modi proposed the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI) at the 14th East Asia Summit in November 2019, held at:
nf0d2d22c7e8.x: IPOI was proposed at the 14th EAS in Bangkok; it is an open, non-treaty initiative with seven pillars that builds on SAGAR.

nc6a6036c197.s: The Agalega airstrip and jetty project is located in:
nc6a6036c197.x: Agalega is in Mauritius; Assumption Island is in Seychelles; Uthuru Thila Falhu and Hanimaadhoo are in the Maldives.

nd2bf707464b.s: Which of the following India–US foundational agreement–purpose pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: GSOMIA – Protection of shared military information
LEMOA – Access to each other's facilities for refuelling and replenishment
COMCASA – Encrypted communications data and equipment
BECA – Encrypted communications data and equipment
nd2bf707464b.x: BECA (2020) concerns geospatial (satellite) data for navigation and missile targeting; encrypted communications is COMCASA.

nf8baf5944e6.s: Which of the following exercise–character pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Red Flag – US Air Force multinational exercise
nf8baf5944e6.x: Yudh Abhyas is an Army exercise.

n7c91f5b60e8.s:
Assertion (A): The provisions of the Pressler Amendment (1985) were applied to Pakistan in 1990.
Reason (R): The Amendment barred US aid to Pakistan unless the US President certified that Pakistan did not possess a nuclear device.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n7c91f5b60e8.x: The Amendment tied aid to presidential certification on Pakistan's nuclear capability, which is why its bar on aid was applied in 1990.

n65878269cb6.s: GE F414 jet engines are to be co-produced in India with:
n65878269cb6.x: GE F414 engines are to be co-produced with HAL, not BEL; iCET (2023) was relaunched as TRUST in 2025.

n48820fed29e.s: The India–US Strategic and Commercial Dialogue dates from:
n48820fed29e.x: The Strategic and Commercial Dialogue dates from 2015; the 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue from 2018.

n3e61e63004d.s: The India Semiconductor Mission, launched in December 2021, has an outlay of:
n3e61e63004d.x: The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in December 2021 with an outlay of ₹76,000 crore.

n259a355354d.s: LEMOA, an India–US foundational defence agreement, was signed in:
n259a355354d.x: GSOMIA was signed in 2002, LEMOA in 2016, COMCASA in 2018 and BECA in 2020.

n3c089ea35f8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 23rd India–Russia Annual Summit (New Delhi)?
o: It marked the 25th anniversary of the strategic partnership
It set a $100 billion trade target by 2030
About 96% of bilateral trade is settled in national currencies
n3c089ea35f8.x: Russia joined the International Big Cat Alliance; I2U2 is India, Israel, UAE and USA.

nad568357e49.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India–UAE relations?
o: They have had a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership since 2017
The India-UAE CEPA became operational in 2022
Bilateral trade exceeded $100 billion in FY 2024-25
The UAE is India's second-largest trading partner
nad568357e49.x: With over $100 billion in trade, the UAE is India's third-largest trading partner, not second.

ncd3c03cbf7d.s:
Assertion (A): Defence is a key pillar of the India–Israel Special Strategic Partnership.
Reason (R): The partnership excludes joint research and development in defence.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncd3c03cbf7d.x: Defence is a key pillar, and cooperation includes manufacturing, technology and joint R&D, so R is false.

n61b55fa0037.s: The Mumbai–Ahmedabad High Speed Rail project, supported by Japanese ODA, uses which technology?
n61b55fa0037.x: The project uses Japan's Shinkansen technology with Japanese ODA support.

n209207070d7.s: The II India–Africa Forum Summit (2011) was held at:
n209207070d7.x: The I (2008) and III (2015) Summits were in New Delhi; the II Summit (2011) was in Addis Ababa.

nfcb602c89de.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the principal organs of the United Nations?
o: The General Assembly has all 193 members, with one vote each
The Security Council has 15 members and its decisions bind members
The Secretariat is headed by the Secretary-General
The Trusteeship Council has remained active continuously since 1994
nfcb602c89de.x: The Trusteeship Council has been inactive since 1994, after Palau attained self-government.

nbec73304fa5.s: Which of the following is NOT a purpose listed in Article 1 of the UN Charter?
nbec73304fa5.x: Sovereign equality is stated in Article 2, not Article 1.

nb8c0bb814a3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Inter-Governmental Negotiations (IGN) on UNSC reform?
o: It is an informal working group of the UN General Assembly
An annual 'Elements Paper' maps points of agreement and disagreement
It is a subsidiary body of the Security Council in which the P5 veto applies
nb8c0bb814a3.x: The IGN is a General Assembly process, not a Security Council body.

n6ae93c7c7b4.s:
Assertion (A): A retiring non-permanent member of the UN Security Council is eligible for immediate re-election.
Reason (R): Non-permanent members are elected by the UNGA by a two-thirds secret ballot for 2 years.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n6ae93c7c7b4.x: Article 23 bars immediate re-election of a retiring non-permanent member; the election rule in R is correct.

n51d933453ce.s: The Ezulwini Consensus (2005) demands for Africa:
o: Two permanent seats with veto, plus five non-permanent seats
n51d933453ce.x: Ezulwini demands two permanent seats with veto plus five non-permanent seats for Africa.

nf81f62c3e76.s: The UNSC Counter-Terrorism Committee set up after 9/11 was created by Resolution:
nf81f62c3e76.x: 1373 (2001) set up the Counter-Terrorism Committee; 1267 covers Al-Qaida/ISIL sanctions and 1540 WMD and non-state actors.

n9113ee6d341.s: The 'Uniting for Peace' resolution (Resolution 377) of the UN General Assembly was adopted in:
n9113ee6d341.x: Resolution 377 was adopted in 1950 and first used in the 1956 Suez Crisis.

nd3239be22d0.s: The first African Secretary-General of the United Nations was:
nd3239be22d0.x: Boutros Boutros-Ghali of Egypt was the first African SG; Kofi Annan came after him. U Thant was the first Asian SG.

n47a8365e7c9.s: The ICJ gave its unanimous advisory opinion on climate obligations in:
n47a8365e7c9.x: The ICJ issued the unanimous climate advisory opinion in July 2025.

n59babea084e.s: The first Secretary-General of the United Nations was:
n59babea084e.x: Trygve Lie took office in 1946, followed by Hammarskjold (1953), U Thant (1961) and Waldheim (1972).

na077c575233.s:
Assertion (A): The ILO has a tripartite structure of governments, employers and workers.
Reason (R): Its tripartite structure operates in the International Labour Conference and ECOSOC.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
na077c575233.x: The ILO is tripartite, but its tripartite bodies are the International Labour Conference and the Governing Body, not ECOSOC.

n7b88e26e514.s: India's second UNESCO City of Gastronomy, after Hyderabad (2019), is:
n7b88e26e514.x: Lucknow followed Hyderabad as India's second City of Gastronomy.

n07d85b79c12.s: The protection of refugees is the mandate of:
n07d85b79c12.x: Refugees are UNHCR's mandate; UNICEF deals with children's rights and UNEP with climate, biodiversity and pollution.

n36c30ec98cc.s: UNICEF won the Nobel Peace Prize in:
n36c30ec98cc.x: UNICEF won in 1965, the ILO in 1969, UN Peacekeeping Forces in 1988, and the UN with Kofi Annan in 2001.

n01210833e81.s: India has NOT ratified which pair of ILO Fundamental Conventions?
n01210833e81.x: India has not ratified C87 (Freedom of Association) and C98 (Right to Organise and Collective Bargaining); the other pairs are ratified.

n48f82d50945.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the IMF?
o: The IMFC advises the Board of Governors
Article IV consultations are annual bilateral surveillance of each member's economy
The IMF is headquartered at New York
n48f82d50945.x: The IMF is headquartered at Washington D.C., not New York.

n764b9c945f9.s:
Assertion (A): The BRICS New Delhi Declaration of September 2026 demanded quota and voting reform in the IMF and World Bank.
Reason (R): The Global North, with about 15% of the population, holds about 60% of the votes in these institutions.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n764b9c945f9.x: The declaration demanded reform because of the unequal distribution of population and voting power, so R explains A.

ne64880bed7b.s: Which World Bank Group institution provides political-risk insurance and guarantees for foreign investors?
ne64880bed7b.x: MIGA gives political-risk insurance; IDA gives interest-free credits and grants, and IFC handles private-sector investment.

n14678a27f02.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of IMF quotas?
o: Fixing the exchange rate of every member's currency
n14678a27f02.x: Quotas determine contribution, borrowing access and voting power; they do not fix exchange rates.

n5ddfc621ce7.s: The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor is identified with which bank?
n5ddfc621ce7.x: The corridor is identified with ADB; AIIB co-funds MUTP-III and NIIF Phase II, and the AP Disaster Recovery Project is with the World Bank.

nindian-economy-31-4.s: The International Development Association (IDA) was established in:
nindian-economy-31-4.x: IDA was set up in 1960 and gives concessional loans and grants; the IFC was set up in 1956.

nfcafdac53b5.s: The Smithsonian Agreement of 1971, which replaced the Bretton Woods parities, lasted about:
nfcafdac53b5.x: The Smithsonian Agreement lasted only about 14 months, not 14 years.

n23f50567ade.s: Since October 2016, the SDR basket has consisted of how many currencies?
n23f50567ade.x: The basket has five currencies since October 2016: US dollar, euro, renminbi, yen and pound.

nb3779e421fa.s: The idea of the New Development Bank was mooted at the 4th BRICS Summit (2012) held at:
nb3779e421fa.x: The NDB idea came at the 4th BRICS Summit in New Delhi in 2012; it began operations in 2015 with equal voting rights and no veto.

na8bcecc77e4.s: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank began operations in:
na8bcecc77e4.x: AIIB's Articles were signed in 2015 and operations began in January 2016; it holds an AAA rating.

n4ede788e676.s: The Asian Development Bank (1966) was created at the initiative of:
n4ede788e676.x: ADB was created at UN-ESCAP's initiative, not UNCTAD's; India is a founding member.

nindian-economy-28-5.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the IMF?
nindian-economy-28-5.x: Project financing is the World Bank's job; the IMF promotes monetary stability, gives technical help and lends for BoP problems.
